excerpt.en: [Root.GetName] has been partially hollowed out and carved with exquisite precision. There is something familiar about the lines and curves etched into the rock...

texts.zh:
小行星的大部分地方都被激光精细雕刻过，看上去像小型的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]庙宇：这是一座供奉着未叙尊者的古龛，祂是诸多[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]古旧信仰中专司毁灭的神祇。

这座古龛已经在太空中盘旋了许久，比我们掌握太空航行技术的时间还要更加久远——这个发现让我们很多的研究者们百思不得其解。

由于发现的这一物体仍正体不明，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]建议我们寻找更多与这个宇宙古龛有相似特征的天体。[Root.leader.GetHeSheCap][Root.leader.GetHasHave]准备了一份附近恒星系中可能的候选列表。
texts.en:
Most of the asteroid has been laser-chiseled with great precision into the likeness of a small [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] temple: a shrine to the Untold, great destroyer-deity of several old [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] faiths.

The temple has been tumbling through the quiet of space for longer than we have been capable of space-flight - a finding which disturbs more than a few of our researchers.

Despite the unsettling nature of this discovery, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has suggested we search for more objects matching the characteristics of this space temple. [Root.leader.GetHeSheCap] [Root.leader.GetHasHave] prepared a list of likely candidates in nearby star systems.

label.zh: 不去管这些东西也许是最好的。
label.en: Perhaps it would be best if we did not.

tooltips.zh: 就让沉睡的神灵继续沉睡着吧。

label.zh: 我们不会受这种异端的影响。
label.en: We will not suffer this heresy.

tooltips.en: Order the [Root.GetName] to raze the shrine.

# 被雕琢的小行星 / An Asteroid, Carved

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/01_anomaly_categories.txt:297-330` · `events/anomaly_events_1.txt:1746-1860` · `common/event_chains/`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-13（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 3级异常，权重3；仅限非AI、非人类（或首都不在太阳系）的玩家小行星；群体意识或“巨人的肩膀”起源权重为0。  
  Level-3 anomaly, weight 3; only for non-AI players that are not human or whose capital is not in the Sol system, on asteroids; factor 0 for gestalt consciousness and Shoulders of Giants.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 单一结局140“熟悉的神龛”（研究）：选项b（需要三个旧神星系星旗都存在）开启“旧神神龛”事件链（old_gods_chain）；选项a/c（狂热灵性主义者用c）结束事件链。  
  Single outcome 140 (research): option b (needs all three old_gods_system star flags) begins the Shrines to the Old Gods chain (old_gods_chain); option a / c (c for fanatic spiritualists) ends the chain.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 结局：进入旧神事件链或终止。  
  Outcomes: the Old Gods chain or ending it.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 按是否狂热灵性主义者选项a/c不同。  
  Option a/c depends on fanatic spiritualism.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已对照事件140的选项脚本（1746-1860）。  
  Checked the option script of event 140 (1746-1860).
